title: Family of all-ones circuits
statement: Define a family of circuits indexed by the natural number $n$, where the circuit for inputs in $	ext{Fin }n$ is the depth-one circuit that outputs the product of all input values in $	ext{Fin }2$. Every layer of every circuit in this family has a finite node type.
